thread_title: S. alata 'golden lid' Stone Co, MS
breadcrumb: S. alata 'golden lid' Stone Co, MS

posts.body_html:
Here's a "new one" that was just "discovered" a few weeks ago! The body is reddish and has a nice contrasting yellow lid to it! Before there was a chance to propagate it, the only division that could be taken has already been distributed, so it'll be a few years before it can circulate. Hopefully it doesn't rot away and get lost before that happens, fingers crossed!

Pics taken 1/18/24:


this thing is a work of art, GOSH!
